import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { areaTag } from "./area_tag";
import { areaTagRaw } from "./area_tag_raw";

export const tag = defineTable("tag", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        name: col.varchar({ length: 255 }).notNull(),
        refCount: col.integer().notNull().default(0)
    },
    relations: {
        area_tag: rel.hasMany(() => areaTag, { foreignKey: "tag" }),
        area_tag_raw: rel.hasMany(() => areaTagRaw, { foreignKey: "tag" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
